Find land that can be farmed — and know why.

PotharSight Assam · পথাৰছাইট – an open, explainable decision-support portal

Working prototype on real data · Kamrup (R), Cachar, Lakhimpur, Dibrugarh · web + mobile · English + অসমীয়া

The problem

Assam reports large areas of culturable waste and fallow land – but only as district totals in tables.

  • Planners cannot see where it is, how suitable it is, or why
  • Satellite, soil, flood and statistics sit with different offices
  • Site selection takes weeks and is hard to audit
  • Programmes are spread thinly instead of targeted

Our solution

Free satellite & GIS data
Sentinel-1/2, WorldCover, DEM, soil, rain, OSM
→
Is it available?
vacant · long fallow · rabi fallow
→
Is it suitable?
6 factors, hard limits, S1–N
→
Why?
factor scores, limiting factor, reason
→
Where first?
ranked patches, blocks, circles
→
Dashboard + GIS downloads
  • Integrates 9 open layers on one 30 m grid
  • Ranks & classifies against stated FAO-style criteria
  • Explains every result in plain language
  • Downloads GPKG, SHP, GeoJSON, GeoTIFF, CSV
  • Programme profiles: field crops, horticulture (+ any crop)
  • Live weights – each department asks its own question

Every result explains itself

Rank 1 · Boko · 11.2 ha · Seasonal (rabi) fallow cropland

S1 Highly suitable. Strong: gentle terrain, water availability. Main limitation: soil fertility.

  • Six 0–100 factor scores per cell and patch
  • Limiting and strongest factor stored as GIS layers
  • Criteria and data sources recorded → auditable, challengeable decisions

Validated against evidence

DistrictSatellite vacant + long fallow / official Active farmland rated S1/S2Ranking stability (±20 % weights, min ρ)
Kamrup (R)13,651 / 31,453 ha94 %0.996
Cachar13,768 / 26,064 ha99 %0.989
Lakhimpur11,402 / 23,062 ha91 %1.0
Dibrugarh14,435 / 22,546 ha99 %1.0

Imagery spot-check: 84 of 120 random priority sites consistent with open / fallow / cultivable land (Kamrup (R) 22/30, Cachar 21/30, Lakhimpur 22/30, Dibrugarh 19/30); doubtful cases are mostly shifting river channels – field verification in the pilot.

Synthetic end-to-end test, data register and validation report on every run. Pilot: field verification of ~100 stratified patches per district.

Built to scale across Assam and beyond

To add…Effort
A new district1 line in config.yaml → run
A new stateSwap boundary layers (all satellite data is national/global)
A new crop / programmeNew profile: limits + weights
ASSAC / department data (LULC, Soil Health Card, ASDMA flood, cadastre)Replace a layer file – no code change

Open & low-cost: 100 % free data, open-source stack, runs on a laptop; outputs load into Bhuvan, QGIS, ArcGIS.
